"""Live control record for the RoboPaint rcb-limited episode."""
import sys, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = Path('/app/runs')
R = Robot()
SPEC = R.spec()
(OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(SPEC, indent=2))

def pose_now():
    o = R.get_obs(video='none')
    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], dtype=float)

def lin_targets(end, n=40, dt=0.05, q=None):
    start = pose_now()
    if q is None: q = start[3:]
    xyz = np.linspace(start[:3], np.asarray(end, float), n+1)[1:]
    return np.column_stack((xyz, np.repeat(np.asarray(q,float)[None,:], n, axis=0)))

def move(end, n=40, q=None, note='move'):
    p = lin_targets(end, n=n, q=q)
    return R.submit('ee_pose', p, dt=0.05, video='both', video_fps=8, note=note)

def save_obs(name, cameras=None, depth=True):
    o=R.get_obs(cameras=cameras, depth=depth, video='none')
    base=RUNS/name; base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    o.save(str(base))
    return o

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(R.status())
    print('tip', pose_now())
